page.layout: One printed page: running head at the top, then one column of text in the main block. The fragments at the far left are the edge of the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: refugium est, non ut praecedentia ratione suadet, sed vi vel inuitos cogit, minatur enim se Apostolicae & ecclesiasticae authoritatis gladio has factiosas dissensiones resecaturum, vnaque cum authoribus ex ecclesia eiecturum.

p.i: 18 Tanquam autem non venturo me, inflati sunt quidam.
19 Veniam autem cito ad vos, si dominus voluerit & cognoscam non sermonem inflatorum, sed virtutem.
20 Nam regnum dei, non est in sermone, sed in virtute.
21 Quid vultis? in virga veniam ad vos, an in charitate & in spiritu mansuetudinis?

page.notes: The left-hand fragments belong to the neighbouring page and were left out. The "Verf." at the lower right is possibly a catchword (abbreviation of Versus) and is recorded as one. The opening mark before "Tanquam" in verse 18 is a decorated initial T, read here as T. Verse 18 is printed with "inflati" and "sunt" in italic, as set above.
